# Finance Tracker add-on repository

Home Assistant add-on repository for a private household finance tracker.

**Generated, do not edit here.** CI in the private `finance-tracker` repository
syncs this repository from its `addon/` folder after every publish. Changes made
here are overwritten.

The add-on runs a prebuilt image from `ghcr.io/bot-benedict/finance-tracker`,
which is private. Adding this repository only works on a Home Assistant whose
Supervisor is logged in to that registry; see the add-on's Documentation tab.
